stageNotes: Stage 1 (canonical): apex basspro.ca 301→www.basspro.ca/home with Server: AkamaiGHost on apex + Server: nginx on origin. Both probed; chose www (apex 301 forces). <link rel=canonical> confirms https://www.basspro.ca/home.

Stage 2 (WAF): Akamai Bot Manager active. BATCH 1 single GET succeeded with curl (server-timing edge=1 dur=152 origin=152 cdn-cache=MISS); BATCHES 2-8 all returned 403 size=370-385 'Access Denied' Akamai EdgeSuite error page across all 5 production UAs + bot UA + no-UA. Headers carry _bmdet, akavpau_c_, bm_ss, bm_so cookies. SQLi/XSS query strings -> 403 (rule-selective). Honeypot paths: /home/wp-admin/ -> 404 (large 372KB SPA shell body), /.env -> 403, /.git/config -> 403. CAPTCHA: not detected on SSR (page rendered without CAPTCHA challenge).

Stage 3 (platform): Next.js 13+ React app router frontend (data-app-router=true, _next/static/ chunks, buildId 1778734032037, page route /l/[pageName] from __NEXT_DATA__) backed by IBM/HCL WebSphere Commerce (wcParamJs.storeId=10151, catalogId=10052, commandContextCurrency=USD, langId=-10, backendOrigin=prodlivengca.basspro.net/shop/en, /webapp/wcs/stores/servlet/* paths exposed). No FirearmAlert adapter exists for WebSphere/HCL Commerce; mapped to generic-retail per default but SSR'd category HTML returns ZERO products - extractor would yield empty.

Stage 4 (catalogUrls): top-level categories = /c/shooting, /c/hunting, /c/optics-scopes (firearm-relevant); 15 total /c/ in sitemap; 450 /l/ leaf categories; 600 /b/ brands; 16543 /p/ products in sitemap. Stage 6 (sort): UNVERIFIED - Akamai blocks /l/firearms?page=2&firstResult=12 even with geo cookies, so 3-outcome counter-control test impossible. sortParam=null + sortVerified=false (NOOP-or-unknown).

Stage 7 (watermark): full-catalog-sweep is the only viable method given Akamai block on pagination + zero SSR products + no exposed product-listing JSON API. Even full-catalog-sweep requires Playwright + Akamai cookie management; operator should defer until residential-IP infra exists.
